name: Belphemon: Rage Mode
main_effect:
[Start of Your Main Phase] Delete all of your opponent's level 5 or lower Digimon. Then, if you have 6 or less cards in hand, this Digimon gets +3000 DP and ＜Security A. +1＞ for the turn. (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
[End of Attack] [Once Per Turn] By deleting 1 of your other Digimon, unsuspend this Digimon.
source_effect: [End of Opponent's Turn] If this Digimon is [Belphemon: Sleep Mode], trash the top card of this Digimon.
